Automatic Backflushing

A system that automatically reverses flow through filters or strainers to remove debris and maintain performance without manual intervention.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Automatic Backflushing?

In this glossary, Automatic Backflushing refers to: A system that automatically reverses flow through filters or strainers to remove debris and maintain performance without manual intervention.

How is Automatic Backflushing used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Initiate automatic backflushing if filter differential pressure exceeds limits; monitor system until pressure returns to normal."

Why does Automatic Backflushing matter in maritime?

Automatic Backflushing matters because it supports clear communication in Engineering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Automatic Backflushing is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Definition

A system that automatically reverses flow through filters or strainers to remove debris and maintain performance without manual intervention.

Operational example
